name: 34337-fixedio-gptoss120b-8gpu
hardware: 8x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one whole a3 node, --gres=gpu:8), sm90.
parallelism: TP=8, PP=1, DP=1, EP off; one vLLM engine on one node.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=8, warmup 10%, cooldown 10%, bounded at 320 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, seed static 34337; hold concurrency within 4-16.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, temperature 0, exactly 1024 prompt and 1024 output tokens per request (min = max on both, `ignore_eos` with a hard `max_tokens`); the engine renders and tokenizes the prompt, so the reported prompt count lands a few tokens above 1024.
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant on a 120-billion-parameter model, serving eight concurrent users uniform page-length prompts and replies across one eight-GPU node.
